# BBC

> > The British Broadcasting Corporation's public service broadcaster providing news, sport, culture, and entertainment across the United Kingdom's nations and regions.

BBC serves audiences across Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland, and other UK regions with dedicated homepages in English, Welsh (Cymru), and Scottish Gaelic (Alba). The corporation delivers comprehensive coverage of local news, rugby union, darts, horse racing, and cultural programming including radio services like Radio Cymru and television channels like S4C.

## Key Topics

- Wales
- BBC Wales
- Welsh-language broadcasting
- Rugby union
- Regional news
- Sports coverage
- Darts
- Scotland
- Northern Ireland

- S4C
- Premier League Darts
- Horse racing
- Local stories
- Video content

## UK Nations & Regions

- [BBC - Wales - Home](https://www.bbc.com/wales): BBC Wales regional homepage with news, sport, and Welsh content
- [BBC - Scotland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/scotland): BBC Scotland regional homepage covering news, politics, and Scottish sport
- [BBC - Northern Ireland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/northernireland): BBC Northern Ireland homepage with local news, sport, and Radio Ulster

## Welsh & Gaelic Language Services

- [BBC - Cymru - Home](https://www.bbc.com/cymru): BBC Cymru Welsh-language homepage for news, culture, and media
- [BBC - Alba - Home](https://www.bbc.com/alba): BBC Alba Scottish Gaelic homepage for culture, news, and broadcasting
